primary_question: What is the most credible live true positive right now, and what multi-source evidence supports acting on it without reckless isolation?
learning_outcomes: Filter noisy new-queue tops (ZGrab, Large Upload) and still find under_investigation TPs
Read Spike DNS cases: host→DNS VA is not the same as host→C2 IP
Identify agentless NOC clients without name-and-shame
Corroborate TI + DNS volume when IPS has no malware signature on the domain
Decide TP with human next steps and residual uncertainty

steps.title: Triage under noise — find the live TP
steps.learner_objective: Explain why the default new top (Exchange ZGrab / Large Upload) is usually noise, and open {{CASE_PRIMARY}} under investigation.
hints_learner_safe: Critical severity on Exchange RCE at public OWA is often inbound scanners (ZGrab).
Large Upload is a known venue FP class.
Real TPs often sit in under_investigation, not the loudest new card.

steps.title: Read Spike DNS Malware Traffic
steps.learner_objective: Extract source host, domain IoC, remote DNS VA, category, and why the alert is Exfiltration-shaped.
hints_learner_safe: action_remote_ip is the venue DNS VA on port 53 — not the malware C2 A-record.

steps.title: Enrich the domain IoC
steps.learner_objective: Show sole-source: one internal host, high hit count for {{DOMAIN_IOC}}.
hints_learner_safe: Sole-source malware DNS is higher priority than shared SaaS domains.
Hundreds of hits in 72h is beacon-shaped even if answers are NXDOMAIN/sinkholed.

steps.title: Identify the sole-source host
steps.learner_objective: Build agentless identity: NOC WiFi, Mac, operator SaaS profile, privacy MAC — confirm owner offline.
hints_learner_safe: NOC WiFi + Mac + Slack/Anthropic/VS Code = operator-shaped device.
mDNS hostnames are not HR tickets — confirm ownership privately.

steps.title: Corroborate volume + TI (accept IPS gap)
steps.learner_objective: Explain that detection is DNS volume + multi-vendor TI; NGFW threats may be informational only.

suggested_actions.template: Repeated queries host → DNS VA :53 for IoC name

hints_learner_safe: No malware IPS signature on the domain does not cancel Unit42/VT/Google TI + spike volume.
Related inventory may be empty — correlation case is still valid.

steps.title: Disposition: true positive + human actions
steps.learner_objective: Write TP disposition with confidence split (activity real vs active C2 confirmed) and human next steps.
hints_learner_safe: Recommend: confirm owner, block/watch domain, label ground-truth TP.
Do not auto-isolate agentless without human ownership path.
